description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for authentication operations, including user registration, login, and fetching current user information. It manages user creation, credential validation, token generation, and provides endpoints for auth-related interactions.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Response schema containing access token and user info after login or registration.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload with email and password.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for registration request payload with email, password, and full name.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Schema representing publicly viewable user information.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user record.

methods.name: None _ensure_demo_user(db: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Creates a demo user if the user table is empty.

methods.name: AuthResponse register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user registration, including demo user creation, duplicate check, user creation, and token generation.

methods.name: AuthResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles user login, verifying credentials and issuing a token upon success.

methods.name: UserPublic me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's details.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^async def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) -> AuthRespon/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^async def register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) -> Auth/
